api_hash_algorithm.method: Sort recursive ./relative *.aidl paths by C byte order; concatenate sha1sum lines plus prior numeric version and LF, using latest-version for V1; SHA1 the result and compare the last .hash line. Preserve all older recorded hash lines.

limitations: This fixed contract supports explicit candidate-generation opt-in only; it does not inspect or activate a live Android checkout, evaluate Make, build modules or authorize phone actions.
The two namespace exports expose 142 existing literal declarations, including two additional AIDL interfaces; export is not proof of enablement, installation or runtime service selection.

The imported common/FMQ capture contains nine exact regular files and matching retained-file hashes but does not enumerate their directories. Native source guards and normal API checks remain required.
Documentation evidence references do not become runtime file dependencies. Required source bytes are described by source-relative preconditions and pinned lock/snapshot inputs.
The source lock and this contract do not replace private inputs, local patch records, tools, AVB/signing, packaging or hardware validation.

namespace_ownership.limitations: The captured 90 Blueprint bodies establish literal ownership and zero observed literal-name collisions against 92391 retained existing Make assignments. They do not prove future generated aliases, enabled variants, defaults or conditional Make uniqueness; ordinary strict Soong/Kati generation remains required.
